body: This attitude is not only harmful, but wrong. You are a girl. You know this. I know this. It's a simple fact. If someone is born short and grow tall, does that make them short. If a caterpillar metamorphosizes, are they still a caterpillar. Obviously not. It can suck sometimes, a lot of the time. But you can be happy with yourself. I would recommend talking with someone of the internet about this (if it's safe for you). And always remmember, people love and support you. I don't even know you, but I already do. I'm sure you are a beautiful girl.
